_comment: Deliberately declares no firestore.rules, so the emulator runs open. That test exercises the
Android transport's wire behaviour — the batched serverUpdatedAt readback — with a client that
has no auth token, which the real rules correctly reject (isOwner requires request.auth).
Rules are covered separately: tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs and web's notesSync.emulator.test.ts,
both of which run against the real firestore.rules through an authenticated context.
Same port as firebase.json on purpose: these never run concurrently, they run as separate steps.
